title: A bakery in Amsterdam
assumptions: A new Dutch BV opening a bakery with staff, a fit-out and a sign. The operating permit applies if customers eat and drink on the premises; the environment and planning permits apply when the works, the use or the sign need one.

items.name: Private limited company (BV) through a civil-law notary
items.quote: Private limited companies and public limited companies have to register via a civil-law notary.

items.name: Business register entry (KVK)
items.quote: New businesses must register with the Netherlands Chamber of Commerce KVK.

items.name: VAT numbers from the tax office (Belastingdienst)
items.quote: If the Tax Administration sees you as an entrepreneur, you will receive a VAT identification number and a VAT number.

items.name: Employer registration for payroll tax
items.quote: Before you can hire staff, you will first need to register as an employer for social security purposes with the Tax Administration.

items.name: Food business registration with the NVWA
items.quote: If your company manufactures, processes, or sells food products, you must register your business with the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA).

items.name: EU food hygiene rules (Regulation (EC) 852/2004)
items.agency: European Union (Regulation (EC) 852/2004), checked by the national food inspectors
items.quote: All food businesses operating in the EU, regardless of their size or type, must comply with basic hygiene requirements.

items.name: Fire safety measures (checked by the municipality and the fire service)
items.agency: The gemeente (municipality): Gemeente Amsterdam, Gemeente Rotterdam
items.quote: You must also take fire safety measures.

items.name: Catering operating permit for the premises (exploitatievergunning)
items.agency: The gemeente (municipality): Gemeente Amsterdam, Gemeente Rotterdam
items.quote: If customers eat and drink in your restaurant or café you need a catering establishment operating permit
items.condition: Only when it applies to this opening (see the assumptions).

items.name: Environment and planning permit, where the plans don't fit the environment plan
items.agency: The gemeente (municipality): Gemeente Amsterdam, Gemeente Rotterdam
items.quote: If your plans do not fit within the environment plan, you will need to apply for an environment and planning permit
items.condition: Only when it applies to this opening (see the assumptions).

items.name: Permit for the shop sign
items.agency: The gemeente (municipality): Gemeente Amsterdam, Gemeente Rotterdam
items.quote: In that case, you will often need an environment and planning permit as well.
items.condition: Only when it applies to this opening (see the assumptions).

mustNotInclude.name: Alcohol and terrace
mustNotInclude.why: No alcohol, no terrace asked for.

mustNotInclude.name: Product safety and wood rules
mustNotInclude.why: Not a seller of consumer goods or furniture.
